theme_details.rationale: High-density data environments like POS systems and inventory management require extreme clarity, minimal visual noise, and authoritative structure. Swiss High-Contrast ensures data legibility, rapid scanning, and professional reliability. Avoiding soft/playful elements to maintain a serious 'control room' vibe.

typesetting_rules.numbers: Always use tabular nums (tabular-nums) for prices, stock counts, and financial data.
typesetting_rules.labels: Overlines/labels must be uppercase, tiny, and widely spaced.

color_system.contrast_rules: All text must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1). Never use gray-on-gray for essential numbers. Use pure red/green/amber for status indicators, never tinted pastels.

specific_layouts.pos_billing: Split screen layout. Left: 60-70% width for product search/grid. Right: 30-40% width for sticky cart, totals, and checkout CTA. Height must fill viewport (h-screen) to avoid main window scrolling.
specific_layouts.dashboard_overview: Top row: 4 KPI metric cards (col-span-1 each). Middle row: 2 main charts (col-span-2 each). Bottom row: 2 tall lists (e.g., Low Stock Alerts, Recent Invoices).
specific_layouts.auth_mfa: 50/50 split layout. Left: Abstract imagery. Right: Centered login/MFA card.

component_rules.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover adds slight shadow-md. Do not overuse cards inside cards (nested cards).
component_rules.tables: Must have sticky headers. Right-align all numeric columns (price, quantity). Use zebra striping (even:bg-slate-50) for long lists. Include pagination and search filters.
component_rules.buttons: Square or rounded-md corners. No pill shapes. Primary buttons must have high contrast text (text-white). Focus states must include focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:ring-offset-2.
component_rules.inputs: Shadcn defaults but ensure strict 1px border. Background white. Include clear error states (border-red-600, text-red-600).
component_rules.navigation: Vertical left sidebar for standard SaaS navigation. Must be collapsible to maximize horizontal space for POS and tables. Active states in sidebar should use a subtle background (bg-slate-100) and bold primary text.
component_rules.mfa_qr_code: Display inside a padded box with dashed borders (border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300). Include an alternative setup key option below.

motion_interactions.hover: Subtle background shifts (bg-white to bg-slate-50). Button background darkening.
motion_interactions.transitions: Fast and snappy. transition-all duration-150 ease-in-out. Do not use slow floaty animations in a POS system.
motion_interactions.feedback: Use Sonner for toast notifications on successful checkout, inventory update, or errors. Position: top-right.

auth_background.description: Abstract geometric blue background for the left side of the Login/MFA screen.
auth_background.usage: Use with object-cover and a slight dark/blue overlay if text is placed on top, though preferably keep text on the white form side.

pos_placeholder_1.usage: Use in onboarding, marketing, or empty state illustrations for the POS module.

inventory_placeholder.usage: Use in onboarding, reports, or empty state illustrations for the Inventory module.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select, menu items) MUST have a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install standard icons: Use lucide-react (default) or install @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboard data.
Build a Left Sidebar layout with a top header. The Sidebar should collapse to icons-only for POS mode.
For the POS view, disable main window scrolling. Create a flex container where the left product list scrolls independently from the right cart summary.
Use pure Shadcn components but strip excessive border-radii to maintain the 'Swiss' archetype (override rounded-xl to rounded-md).
Never use generic fallback placeholder URLs like via.placeholder.com. ONLY use the provided media_assets.
Implement Recharts for the 'Reports & Analytics' and 'AI Demand Forecasting' modules. Keep charts minimal, using the brand primary (Blue 600) and gray axes.
Ensure 'BASIC', 'STANDARD', and 'PREMIUM' tiers have distinct visual badges (e.g., Gray, Blue, Gold/Amber) in the Settings/Subscription UI.
